title: Wren and the Protocol
author: August Montrose
blurb: Ansel Thackeray, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, has spent five years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
